label: Rule composition and phase
title: When does the order of CA rules change the cycles?
summary: Cyclic rotations of a rule schedule have identical periodic-cycle counts on every finite ring. One frozen 30/54/110 comparison shows a noncyclic permutation changes the cycles at widths 4, 6 and 8.
takeaway: A first rule filters which later order differences are visible; compare any claimed benefit against the equivalent fused CA and charge its rule schedule.
